"The Flapper" is an entertaining comedy. This film illustrates the
work of Olive Thomas, a star of Silent Hall of Fame.

Directed by             
  Alan Crosland
Produced by              
Myron Selznick
Screenplay by            Frances
Marion
Story by              
       Frances Marion
Starring              
       Olive Thomas, Theodore Westman Jr., William P.
Carleton, Katherine Johnston, Arthur Housman
Cinematography        John W. Brown
Distributed by           
Selznick Pictures Corporation
Release date            
   May 10, 1920
Running time             
88 mins.
Country              
        United States
Language             
       Silent, English intertitles
